full_judgment:
Md. Ruhul Amin J: This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment dated April 27, 2004 passed in Civil Revision No. 1202 of 1999 rejecting the application filed under Order 41, Rule 21 read with section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for re-hearing of the Rule upon setting aside the judgment and order dated June 16, 2003 making the Rule absolute. The High Court Division made the Rule absolute on the finding that the opposite party failed to make out a case that the heba was not acted upon. The appellate Court upon allowing the appeal decreed the suit which was filed seeking cancellation of the heba dated June 25, 1986. 

 2. The trial Court dismissed the suit. The appellate Court reversed the judgment and decree of the trial Court and thereupon granted the relief prayed in the suit i.e. declaring the Heba dated 25.6.1989 not legal as was not acted upon. As stated hereinbefore the High Court Division made the Rule absolute on the finding that plaintiff failed to establish that the heba was not acted upon. The Rule obtained by the defendant was disposed of in the absence of the plaintiff opposite party. Thereupon the opposite party filed an application for re-hearing of the Rule.
